naslov: Memphis hosts Denver on home skid
tekst:
Denver Nuggets (5-4, 10th in the Western Conference) vs. Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, seventh in the Western Conference)
              Memphis, Tennessee; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EST
              BOTTOM LINE: Memphis hosts Denver looking to end its three-game home losing streak.
              Memphis went 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action last season. The Grizzlies averaged 114.7 points per game while allowing opponents to score 120.7 last season.
              Denver went 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets gave up 116.9 points per game while committing 19.1 fouls last season.
              INJURIES: Grizzlies: Scotty Pippen Jr.: out (back), Isaiah Stewart: out (knee).
              Nuggets: Julian Strawther: out (knee).
